listing.summary: Enchances and fixes many of the Mk1's modular ship issues!
listing.aiSummary: Enhances and fixes issues with the vanilla modular ship.

description:
Onslaught Mk1 Enhanced

Enchances and fixes many of the Mk1's modular ship issues!

Adds a armor paperdoll preview to ship info!

Spoiler

Fixes explosions bypassing modular armor!

Spoiler

Fixes enemies targeting armor as if it's a dangerous ship!

After working on Knights of Ludd and Scy, modular ships have been my bread and butter. This is a mini mod for the new vanilla modular ship that includes all the fixes/enhancements I developed for those mods.

Changelog:

Spoiler
Version 1.0.3
- Fixed another NPE

Version 1.0.2
- Fixed duplicated .ship contents (resulting in duplicated mounts)

Verison 1.0.1
- Fixed NPE

Verison 1.0.0
- Initial Release
